nom: Differin Resurfacing Acne Scar Spot Treatment Gel

segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, itching, redness or breakouts from this gel, though one sensitive-skin reviewer reports swelling, redness and multiple breakouts after a single use.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her fourth decade reports the gel fades scars slowly with consistent use and does not cause breakouts or irritation.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer notes that as she gets older, scars take longer to heal or become permanent, and reports the gel helped smooth and lighten scars over weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the gel as moisturizing, hydrating or non-drying, with several saying it did not dry out or peel their skin; one reviewer's first use nonetheless left her face dry, red and swollen.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness from acne scars and one mentions the gel helped with facial redness generally; one reviewer reports the gel caused new redness and swelling, possibly dermatitis.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer suspects the product's exfoliating ingredient (aha/bha or retinol-like) irritated her skin barrier, causing redness and swelling; most other reviewers report no irritation or barrier disruption.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of acne scars, dark spots and hyperpigmentation with consistent use over weeks to months, though several report no noticeable change even after weeks of use and one felt the product simply didn't work.
concerns.blemishes: Long-term users with cystic or hormonal acne report clearer skin and fewer new breakouts, but a few reviewers state the gel caused new breakouts or clogged pores on first use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the gel does not feel heavy or greasy despite being labeled as containing dimethicone, while another reviewer specifically flags dimethicone as a pore-clogging silicone.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting tube, good value per use

extraits.titre: Made my face swollen and breakout
extraits.texte: I used this product for one night! One! And it made my face red and super dry. It was horrible. And then the next day my face was swollen and puffy. Along with multiple breakouts! Would not recommend for sensitive skin.
caused my face to become red and swollen, may have caused dermatitis. there's an ingredient in it that must be like aha/ bha or retinol, something that can irritate the skin barrier.

extraits.titre: MUST BUY FOR SCARS AND LARGE PORES
extraits.texte: I had severe acne for years & I was left with scars from years of acne and large pores. it's been 2 weeks and I've already seen a difference in my scars & noticed improvement in my pores just after a few days. A must have. I'm normally sensitive to most products but I have no issues using this product

extraits.titre: The best for pores and scars!
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this! Better than some of the high end products I have tried without success. Hormones have wrecked havoc on my skin causing acne, blackheads and texture. Also have mild redness in my cheeks. This has completely been a game changer. Not only did it help my scars but it's made the texture go away and pores have gotten smaller! Hormones had made them huge and not they're not as bad anymore. Also, I have been using this in the morning in place of my moisturizer and my makeup goes over it beautifully. This is a win win! Definitely a staple in my rotation.

The Differin Resurfacing Acne Scar Gel gives great results if you are consistent. For reference I have been using this 2x per day on both facial acne (cystic) scars and on body acne scars. This product doesn't magically get rid of scars overnight... but, it does give realistic results with consistent use. After 10 days the very noticeable scars on my inner thighs and back area have been reduced. The spots that I have applied this to are almost half as noticeable as the ones I did not use this in.

I was excited and hopeful to try Differin Resurfacing Acne Scar Gel...as an adult who has struggled with acne of varying degrees of severity for my entire life, I have my fair share of mild scarring. And I am happy to report that Differin is making a difference, but patience is definitely required. After using it on my face and back, I feel like my scarring is fading compared to places I haven't been applying it (for reference). Obviously I've given up ever getting rid of acne altogether, it is relatively mild, in this my fourth decade of life, and I can say that the Differin definitely isn't causing breakouts. It isn't irritating on the skin, doesn't have an odor, moisturizes, and absorbs well. For me, this alone is half the battle for better, clearer skin. I apply twice a day, morning and evening, and fortunately it doesn't stain my clothing or pajamas, so it doesn't slow down my routine. It spreads easily, so it has lasted me quite a long time (longer than the size of the container suggests.) This product requires diligent use, and a marathon mindset...it isn't a magic, and you won't see improvement overnight. But results do come. Slowly, which can be hard, and frustrating. But I didn't get my scars overnight, so apart from surgery, I don't expect them to depart any quicker. I like how the Differin makes my skin feel, and I like how it's fading acne scars that I've grown very tired of seeing. I do recommend.

I started using this resurfacing gel as I had surgery on my head. There is a nice scar left over from the surgery. After 3 days of applying daily, I have seen slight results! I will need to continue to use it, but defiantly recommend as I do see less of an apperance or the scar. I do recommend for sensitive skin users as well. I have sensitive skin and have not broken out from the gel.
